exposure: Location within the uterus (cesarean scar vs. uterine cavity)
outcome: Expression intensity of integrin b3 in decidua
Expression intensity of Leukaemia Inhibitory Factor (LIF) in decidua
cohort: The study included 20 women diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy and 20 women with normal pregnancies.
finding: The expression intensities of integrin b3 and LIF in the cesarean scar decidua of women with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy were significantly higher than in the uterine cavity of CSP women and the cesarean scar of normal pregnancy women.
mod_finding: The findings suggest that increased expression of integrin b3 and LIF in the cesarean scar decidua, a consequence of prior cesarean section, might be associated with embryo implantation in the scar, thus linking the mode of birth (cesarean section) to the mechanism of Cesarean Scar Pregnancy.
cross-section timing: At the time of decidual tissue collection for immunohistochemical analysis.
